summary.en: Renting a room is a private contract, and conditions differ by property and company. Search online, or tell a real estate agent what you want and ask for introductions. Viewing a room is free, and you do not have to apply after viewing. The ID documents needed to apply or sign differ by property and agent, so check in advance (foreign nationals may be asked for a residence card or similar). Some agents cannot help you in English, so bring someone who speaks Japanese if you can. From application to move-in usually takes 1 to 2 weeks. Check the lease and ask the real estate agent (to be checked).
